title: Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease in a National Population-based Cohort
brief_summary: This study evaluates the treatment of newly diagnosed gastro-esophageal reflux disease in a Danish national cohort, comparing medical and surgical treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Danish adult patient with GERD-diagnosis verified by upper endoscopy 1997-2014

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any diagnosis of cancer in the gastrointestinal tract during follow-up
* Patients with GERD-diagnosis within previous four years or with concomitant diagnosis requiring independent anti-secretory treatment will be excluded (DK25.0-9, DK26.0-9, DK27.0-9, DK22.7 \& DE16.4B).
study_population:
Patient selection will be done through the Danish National Patient Register. Included will be the period 2000-2015 for a total of 15 years of follow-up.

All adult Danish patients diagnosed with GERD and GERD-related diagnosis will be identified (ICD-10 DK21.0-21.9B \& DK20.9B). Patients with GERD-diagnosis within previous two years or with concomitant diagnosis requiring independent anti-secretory treatment will be excluded (DK25.0-9, DK26.0-9, DK27.0-9, DK22.7 \& DE16.4B). To validate GERD-diagnosis, upper endoscopy must have been performed no more than three months before time of diagnosis.
